action: UK critical infrastructure, government and larger organisations: use the NCSC's Find a Provider page to choose an assured CyAS supplier, and consider adversary simulation alongside the Cyber Assessment Framework and Cyber Resilience Audit.
exec: UK critical-sector bodies get an assured route to adversary-simulation testing; regulators may use it as common evidence.
plain: Britain's cyber agency started a scheme that vets companies offering realistic mock attacks, so important organisations can choose a trusted firm to test their defences.

key_findings: The NCSC launched the Cyber Adversary Simulation (CyAS) scheme, which assures suppliers of adversary simulation services against an NCSC-defined standard.
It is aimed at the UK's most critical organisations and their Cyber Oversight Bodies, with larger organisations, critical national infrastructure and government highlighted.
Providers do reconnaissance, build customer-specific attack plans and pursue agreed objectives without being limited to purchased threat intelligence or documented techniques.
CyAS complements the Cyber Assessment Framework and the Cyber Resilience Audit scheme and was developed with regulators and lead government departments.
The scheme launches as a minimum viable product so the NCSC can test demand and refine the method; the release names no providers.
recommendations: Use the scheme's Find a Provider page to identify assured adversary simulation providers.
Consider CyAS alongside the Cyber Assessment Framework and Cyber Resilience Audit to build a fuller picture of security and resilience.

summary: The UK's NCSC launched the Cyber Adversary Simulation (CyAS) scheme on November 11. It assesses commercial suppliers against an NCSC standard so that critical organisations, government and their oversight bodies can pick trusted providers to run realistic simulated attacks. It sits alongside the Cyber Assessment Framework and Cyber Resilience Audit scheme and starts as a minimum viable product while demand and method are tested.
title: NCSC (UK) launches Cyber Adversary Simulation scheme to assure attack-simulation providers
